source.section: 10-Q · Item 2, Unregistered Sales of Securities and Use of Proceeds
source.quote: During the three months ended March 31, 2026, the Company did not repurchase any shares of common stock
the Company's Board of Directors eliminated the declaration of quarterly dividends on the Company's common stock starting in the quarter ending March 31, 2026
estimates capital expenditures to be in the range of approximately $125 million to $150 million for the full year 2026
R&D as a percentage of net sales 5.0% 4.1% 90 bps
